note: console values not on the main bus; 5431 and 5432 unchanged

columns.name: t_model
columns.description: model time, same clock as main bus 5431 column 0

columns.name: side
columns.description: side in use (Left 0/Right 1); -1 = unset at start, drive held disabled until 0 or 1

columns.name: weight_kg
columns.description: body weight in use (moment x weight); build default until a valid 5434 mass

columns.name: assist_mode
columns.description: assist mode in use into the Multiport Switch: 1 = RL, 2 = ILC, 3 = fixed K

columns.name: cmd_motor
columns.description: control in [1] motor, as latched by the model

columns.name: imu_ok
columns.description: 1 = IMU sample good and good for 20 ms

columns.name: imu_bad_count
columns.description: rejected IMU samples since app start

columns.name: bif_valid
columns.description: 1 = Bi-LSTM estimate valid (calibrated, side and BIF_mass_kg set); 10 ms

columns.name: bif_cal_progress
columns.description: Bi-LSTM 30 s calibration walk progress 0..1 (dbg element 8); 10 ms

columns.name: bif_bias_ready
columns.description: 1 = gyro bias measured (5 s standing after app start or Calibrate IMU); 1 ms

columns.name: gyro_cal_request
columns.description: gyro_cal_request counter in use; a change re-runs the 5 s gyro bias

columns.name: settings_seq
columns.description: seq of the last accepted 5434 settings packet (0 = none yet)

columns.name: bif_mass_kg
columns.description: body mass in use by the Bi-LSTM (0 = not set yet)
